message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded documentaries that explore global warming and climate change:

| Title | Year | Synopsis |
|-------|------|----------|
| **“An Inconvenient Truth”** | 2006 | Former Vice‑President Al Gore presents scientific evidence on climate change and its global impacts. |
| **“An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power”** | 2017 | A follow‑up that examines progress (or lack thereof) since the first film and highlights new scientific findings. |
| **“Before the Flood”** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels the world to witness the effects of climate change and discusses solutions. |
| **“Climate Change: The Facts”** | 2019 | A BBC documentary that explains the science behind global warming and its consequences. |
| **“The 11th Hour”** | 2007 | A global environmental documentary featuring voices from science, business, and faith communities. |
| **“Our Planet”** (Season 1) | 2019 | While primarily a nature series, it includes extensive segments on how climate change is reshaping ecosystems. |

All of these are available on major streaming platforms such as Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, or YouTube (some may require a subscription). If you’d like more details on any particular film or help finding where to stream it, just let me know!
